title: I'm Lum-chan the Notorious! - It's Raining Oil All Over Town
overview:
Ataru Moroboshi, an unlovely flirtatious boy, has been chosen to fight an invading alien force's champion in a 10-day game of tag. If he loses the aliens will invade Earth, but if he wins, the aliens will go home. Ataru isn't at all willing to play tag until he sees the alien's champion: the beautiful Lum.

A group of admirers of Lum try to summon her UFO back to Earth, using Ataru as bait, but instead they get an intergalactic taxi that takes them though subspace, and the fare for the taxi is the value of all the oil on the planet.

title: Mail from Space - Ten-chan Arrives! - Mrs. Swallow and Mrs. Penguin
overview:
A peach falls from the sky, in which Lum's cousin, Ten comes out for a visit. He is capable of breathing fire and is an instant enemy to Ataru.

Ten feeds alien candy to a swallow, making it grow massively in size such that it looks like a penguin. Its appearance in school is just the start of a full day of panic.

title: The Coming of Rei the Handsome Shapechanger! - Die Dreamy-Man!
overview:
Shinobu meets upon Rei, Lum's handsome ex-fiancé, and brings him to Ataru’s house, much to the dismay of Lum.

Ataru and his friends find Rei in a restaurant. His poor Japanese being mocked makes him go wild, and as he chases the boys and Lum throughout town, the chaos grows on.

title: Kintaro from the Autumn Sky! - Gonna Live Like a Man!
overview:
Lum and Ten meet a vicious little boy on top of a flying bear, whom Ataru and Shinobu identify as Kintarō, who came from the sky and is lost.

Kintarō's nanny, with Ataru's help, takes the alien children on a tour of Earth and end up in a preschool where the actual Kintarō learns the myth of the real Kintarō and thus hopes to be a role-model to the kids.

title: Sakura - Raving Beauty of Mystery - Virus in Distress
overview:
Ataru runs away from home, unable to stand the pressure of living with Lum, and bumps into a beautiful lady named Sakura, who takes him to her shrine for exorcism.

Sakura becomes Tomobiki High School’s nurse, and her beauty makes all the boys deliberately injure themselves in order to go see her. But later, they get really sick, which might be connected to Ataru, who oddly enough wants to avoid her.

title: Black Hole Love Triangle - It's a Lovesick Little Demon!
overview:
Lum constantly interferes with Ataru's attempts to reach Shinobu by phone. By barging into their phone conversation from her UFO, it inadvertently creates a black hole that causes aircraft to vanish.

Ataru puts two mirrors together on Friday the 13th and accidentally makes a little demon appear from another dimension.

title: Electric Shocks Scare Me! - Voodoo Dolls of Vengeance
overview:
Cherry gives Ataru a magical yellow ribbon, which when tied to her horns, negate Lum's powers. But will this really allow him to be happy?

After an odd loss of control of his body after dinner, Ataru finds out Lum made a voodoo doll of himself using some clay. Ataru takes advantage of the situation for revenge scheme, until it gives Lum the idea to make a Shinobu doll.

title: Neptune is Beyond My Closet - That Crazy Age of the Dinosaurs
overview:
Ataru, Shinobu and Lum’s Stormtroopers wind up in Neptune through a portal discovered in Ataru’s closet where they are greeted by Lum’s friend Oyuki.

While in the air, Lum, Ataru, Ten and Kintaro accidentally wind up back to the dinosaur age.

title: Princess Kurama, Sleeping Beauty - Athletics in Women's Hell!
overview:
Ataru’s wish upon a star seems to come true as he is selected to awake the Karasutengu Princess Kurama by a kiss and mate with her for a night, but he is not her ideal man.

Still trying to cure Ataru of his lechery, Kurama uses a weird dimensional door where Ataru faces hostile versions of the girls he loves.

title: Pitter Patter Christmas Eve
overview: Lum's Stormtroopers devise a scheme to embarrass Ataru and get Lum to dump him by setting up a fake Christmas Eve date for him.

title: Ataru Genji Goes to the Heian Capital
overview: The normal cast is put into an ancient Japanese story that takes place during the Heian period, with a special guest appearance.

title: Battle Royal of Love - Father You Were Strong
overview:
Sakura invites Ataru and others at a local disco, which is a perfect setting for her boyfriend Tsubame to prove himself worthy of being her fiancée to Cherry by displaying his magic abilities that however go awry.

Kurama takes Ataru back in time in hope of teaching him to be her ideal man like her father.

title: Hawaiian Swimsuit Thief - Full Course From Hell
overview:
During a Hawaiian vacation at a beachside resort, the girls’ swimsuits are stolen. Could Cherry be the culprit?

Still at the resort, Sakura, Ataru and Cherry compete in an all-you-can-eat contest.

title: Mendo Brings Trouble! - Constellation is Spinning
overview:
Tomobiki High School gets a new student: Shutaro Mendo, the son of Japan's richest family. He and Ataru have a duel for presidency of the class.

After a computer told Lum that her perfect matchmade partner is Shutaro instead of Ataru, she shrinks the two down and places them on a Horoscope device.

title: The Great Spring War - The Benten Gang's Return Match
overview:
Lum takes Ataru to her home planet for the Setsubun Battle, but the game goes awry as he goes after the goddess Benten.

Benten shows up for Earth's Setsubun, and a rematch ensues as Ataru angers Lum by taking advantage to play with Benten.

title: Ah Lone Teacher! - Terrifying Visiting Day
overview:
A new teacher, Sanjuro Kuribayashi, has been tasked with bringing order to Class 2-4, and he grows extremely hostile towards Ataru for being Lum’s fiancé.

During parents' visiting day, Lum's Mother and Mrs. Mendo have an all out war against each other.

title: The Fourth Dimension Camera - Demonic Running
overview:
Mendo brings an antique camera to school that sends Ataru off into other worlds.

Ataru strangely becomes amazingly lucky to the point that Mendo loses his popularity.

title: Girls' Day! Introducing Ran-chan - Ran-chan's Invitation
overview:
Ataru is enchanted by a doll that takes him to Ran, Lum’s childhood friend, who is not so joyful about old times when the topic of Rei comes up.

Ran invites Lum and Ataru into her spaceship for a farewell party, but Lum doesn't believe she has given up on sucking Ataru's youth.

title: The Tearful Diary of Tomorrow - Whose Kid Is This?
overview:
Lum acquires Ataru's diary from the next day, which allows her to know what he shall go through today. Ataru tries to use it to his advantage, however...

Mendo finds an alien child in his locker and goes through great lengths to hide it from everyone.

title: Sleepy Serene Springtime Classroom - Peach Blossom Song Contest
overview:
The whole Class 2-4 has fallen asleep due to a tiny spirit taking a make-up exam for her master. However, there is still Ataru, Mendō and Lum to make fall asleep.

A poetry-reading contest takes place at a blossom orchard, where it is said that a wizard of poetry uses a maiden to lure men for a poetry challenge.

title: Duel! Ataru vs Ataru - Wake up to a Nightmare
overview:
By eating a manju Cherry intended to bury, Ataru splits into two, one polite and the other casual.

As Ataru sleeps in class after continuously losing to Lum in a card game the night before, he keeps having weird dreams until meeting a weird fellow feeding nightmares to a baku.

title: Great Space Matchmaking Operation
overview: Lum returns to her home planet unaware that her father is throwing her a matchmaking party. As Ten blabs about it, Ataru uses his spaceship to follow her.

title: Big Springtime Picnic Uproar!
overview: On a school field trip, Ataru gets involved with Kappas and a limestone cavern reveals Mendo's greatest weakness.

title: Beware the Earmuffs!
overview: Ataru and Ten switch bodies after wearing some kind of special earmuffs.

title: Fly Imo-chan!
overview: Ataru becomes the owner of a white caterpillar that Lum's Stormtroopers gave him as it eats a lot more than ordinary caterpillars.

title: Ten-chan's Love
overview: Ten has an unrequited crush on Sakura.

title: What a Dracula
overview: Dracula wants to suck the blood of a beautiful young girl and his target is Lum.

title: Lum's Education Lecture Course for Boys
overview: Lum travels back in time in order to meet a younger Ataru and cure his libido.

title: From the Gardenia with Love
overview: Ataru and Ten compete for the attention of the pretty female proprietor of a flower shop.

title: A Beautiful Girl Brings Rain
overview: The gang meet Tsuyuko, a girl who seems to bring rain wherever she goes.

title: Gimme Back My Horn!
overview: Ten's horn falls off during a fight with Ataru, leaving him weak and unable to breathe fire. Ataru wastes no time in taking advantage of the situation.

title: Shock Library - Quiet Please!
overview: Chaos ensues at the library after the characters in the books start coming to life. Wendy Darling (from J.M. Barrie's Peter Pan novel) enlists Ataru and Lum's help in restoring order.

title: Teacher Hanawa Arrives! It's the Youth
overview: Mr. Hanawa found employment in Ataru's school and at the same time, Lum gets enlisted into it.

title: Goblin in Distress - Wonderful People
overview: A goblin who is living in Mendo's private pool has been shooed out and is trying to find a new home.

title: Darling had It This Time!
overview: Remembering how Lum always got her in trouble when they were younger, Ran devises a new scheme to suck away Ataru's youth.

title: Rei Returns! The Big Study Hall Uproar!
overview: Rei appears and causes an uproar by eating everyone's lunch, and Ran tries her best to win him back.

title: The Coming of The Phantom Red Mantle!
overview: On a cool evening disco dance held by the students at Tomobiki High School during summer break, a mysterious man comes to stalk the girls.

title: Steal Darling! Copy Operation!
overview: Things go wrong when Lum tries to make copies of Ataru in order to protect him from Ran's vengeance.

title: Thrilling Summer Date
overview: Lum and Ataru go on their first date together after Lum watches a television program that makes her realize her relationship with Ataru is abnormal. Ataru, although hesitant at first, shows that he does actually have feelings for Lum, but feels uncomfortable expressing them.

title: So long Byebye Summer Days
overview: Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and Mendo spend their summer vacation at the seaside. First they provoke the wrath of a watermelon god, then they are visited by a crying yōkai.

title: Panic in Typhoon!
overview: A typhoon strikes Tomobiki and floods the Moroboshi household, but Lum has some inventive ways of helping her Darling and his parents cope with the flood waters.

title: Drunkard's Boogie
overview: Lum and Ten get drunk from eating umeboshi, and Lum begins flying around terrorizing Ataru's classmates in order to get more umeboshi.

title: The Terror of Meow
overview: During one of the cats' mating season, Ataru, Lum and Ten meet a beautiful female cat-like humanoid.

title: After You've Gone
overview: Lum's Stormtroopers throw Lum a party, but Ataru spoils it by yelling at Lum and accusing her of ruining his life. Lum leaves for her home planet, and when she doesn't return, Ataru, believing she has gone for good, begins to miss her and tearfully wishes she would return. However, it turns out Lum merely left to renew her passport.

title: Lum-chan's Class Reunion
overview: Lum's friends from outer space plan a surprise class-reunion party for her, but an unaware Lum can't understand why her friends are avoiding her and is hurt.

title: Those Buy-Eaters Gather Round!
overview: Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and the rest of the Tomobiki student body - except for Mendo and his small gang of "good kids" - fight a new school rule which forbids students to leave the campus to eat lunch at fast-food joints.

title: Terror! The Deserted Fossil Grounds Mystery
overview: Ataru, Lum, Mendo, Shinobu, and Jariten all go on a picnic to a remote part of Japan which has some fossils. A group of archaeologists are also exploring this area and using a lot of fancy tricks to make the exploration seem more dramatic than it is.

title: Princess Kurama - A New Challenge!
overview: Kurama has her subjects place her in suspended sleep again in the hopes that some prince may awaken her.

title: The Terrifying Cavity WARS!
overview: Ten has gotten cavities. However, these cavities can be cured by biting 10 people and spreading the cavities to others. To relieve himself, he pays Ataru's class a visit.

title: The Mendo Siblings!
overview: Mendo's manipulative and dangerous younger sister, Ryoko, is introduced.

title: A Cat with a Grudge on the Stairs
overview: Kotatsu-neko is introduced.

title: Can a Raccoon Repay a Favor!?
overview: Ataru helps a wounded bird who transforms itself into a raccoon and moves in to repay the service to Ataru.

title: The Suicide Subspace Parttime Job
overview: Ataru finds the perfect part-time job - a washing attendant at a bathhouse - which he excitedly anticipates as being an opportunity to ogle and grope naked women. However, it doesn't turn out the way he expected.

title: The Big Year-End Party that Lum-chan Organized!
overview: When Lum plans the class's end-of-year party, Ataru explains that New Year's is when you forget who you are. He's a bit worried she took it a bit literally...
